matches_pool_xor_bracket.name: matches_pool_xor_bracket
matches_pool_xor_bracket.value: ("matches"."pool_id" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."bracket_position" IS NULL) OR ("matches"."pool_id" IS NULL AND "matches"."bracket_position" IS NOT NULL)

matches_distinct_teams.name: matches_distinct_teams
matches_distinct_teams.value: "matches"."team_a_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."team_b_id" IS NULL OR "matches"."team_a_id" <> "matches"."team_b_id"

matches_bye_shape.name: matches_bye_shape
matches_bye_shape.value: "matches"."status" <> 'bye' OR ("matches"."team_a_id" IS NOT NULL AND "matches"."team_b_id" IS NULL AND "matches"."winner_team_id" = "matches"."team_a_id")
